item.title: Child’s welfare paramount in custody disputes; but parents’ financial capacity, living standard, and education also matter: Supreme Court
item.description: The Court noted from the mediation report that both children wished to live with their father in Qatar, despite limited memories of the place. The elder child added that their father’s presence alone would be enough, with someone available to care for them. The post Child’s welfare paramount in custody disputes; but parents’ financial capacity, living standard, and education also matter: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Teacher’s selection in private unaided school purely contractual matter; Not amenable to writ jurisdiction: J&K and Ladakh HC
item.description: “The rights arising in favour of candidates participating in the selection process are private rights, which cannot be enforced against an institution that is neither a State nor an instrumentality of the State by way of a writ petition.” The post Teacher’s selection in private unaided school purely contractual matter; Not amenable to writ jurisdiction: J&K and Ladakh HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Not Orwell’s ‘Big Brother’: Supreme Court Clarifies Which Court Can Extend Arbitral Mandate Under Section 29-A
item.description: “The ‘Court’ under Section 29A shall be the Civil Court of ordinary original jurisdiction in a district and includes the High Court in exercise of its original civil jurisdiction under Section 2(1)(e), and shall not be the High Court or the Supreme Court under Section 11(6) of the Act.” The post Not Orwell’s ‘Big Brother’: Supreme Court Clarifies Which Court Can Extend Arbitral Mandate Under Section 29-A appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Allahabad HC pulls up advocate for calling rape victim a woman of “easy virtue”; says it violates dignity & privacy under Article 21
item.description: “Any attempt to portray a woman as being of "easy virtue" or to cast aspersions on her moral character is wholly irrelevant and expressly barred under Section 53A and the proviso to Section 146 of the Evidence Act, 1872.” The post Allahabad HC pulls up advocate for calling rape victim a woman of “easy virtue”; says it violates dignity & privacy under Article 21 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh HC grants bail to Anwar Kadri in forced conversion case; Weekly Police Reporting Ordered
item.description: Considering his criminal antecedents, the Court directed Anwar Kadri to mark his presence before the police station concerned on every Sunday between 12:00 Noon and 04:00 PM till the conclusion of the trial. The post Madhya Pradesh HC grants bail to Anwar Kadri in forced conversion case; Weekly Police Reporting Ordered appeared first on SCC Times.
